skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and calculate key performance indicators (KPIs) in marketing.
Create automated dashboards to track marketing KPIs.
Apply clustering algorithms to segment customers.
Use logistic regression models to predict customer behavior.
Develop decision tree models for predicting customer actions.
Utilize Monte Carlo simulations for estimating customer lifetime value.
Estimate demand curves and optimize pricing strategies.
Build recommendation systems based on content analysis.
Construct collaborative filtering systems for personalized recommendations.
Perform sentiment analysis using Naive Bayes classifiers.
Analyze and solve complex marketing problems using critical thinking.
Effectively communicate technical information and results.
Continuously learn and apply new techniques in marketing analytics.
Use Excel for data analysis and modeling.
Implement marketing analytics solutions using the R programming language.
